concept: Socio - Religious Reform Movements in the 19th and 20th CE India
question: Who founded the Hindu reform organisation Brahmo Samaj?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Raja Ram Mohan Roy**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Raja Ram Mohan Roy** founded the Hindu reform organization **Brahmo Samaj** in **1828**.
 
• Brahmo Samaj was established with the aim of** reforming and modernizing Hindu society**.
 
• The organization played a significant role in the social and religious reform movements in India during the 19th century.
 
• Raja Ram Mohan Roy is often referred to as the "**Father of Modern India**" for his efforts in promoting education, women's rights, and the abolition of practices such as sati.
 
• Brahmo Samaj emphasized the worship of one God and discarded rituals and idol worship.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Raja Ram Mohan Roy** was born on May 22, 1772, in Radhanagar, Bengal.
 
• He was a key figure in the Bengal Renaissance and worked towards the eradication of social evils in India.
 
• He also campaigned against the **caste system and child marriage**, and for the rights of women, including the right to inherit property.
 
• Raja Ram Mohan Roy's efforts led to the abolition of the practice of sati by Lord William Bentinck, the then Governor-General of India, in 1829.
 
• He also **founded the Atmiya Sabha**, which later became part of the Brahmo Samaj movement.
